entry.prompt: Tall slender siege ladder leaning steeply forward on a low curved wooden base: two gently curved pale living-wood rails grown from branches, eight smooth rungs, carved leaf shapes along the rails, a few leafy sprigs and a broad royal blue cloth ribbon tied near the top. Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game, stylized painted realism. Graceful but chunky parts, clean edges, flat faces. The ladder leans toward the front. Isolated, no ground, no wall, no characters, no text.
entry.texture: Stylized matte painted colours, even lighting, no baked shadows. Living wood: silver birch grey (#BDB5A2) with paler carved edges (#E6E0CE). Leaf carvings and sprigs: soft leaf green (#6E9A55) with lighter edges (#9DBB72). Trim: muted gold (#C9A650). Ribbon: saturated royal blue cloth (#2B4FB0), no emblem. No dirt, text or logos.
